resolution: q.48 evil is the privation of a due good and includes non-moral evil. q.94 naturally evil is a practical evaluation contrary to natural law. Data keeps NaturallyEvil and Evil as different predicates on different carriers; no theorem identifies them, and evilPremise need not satisfy Moral. In q.48 a.5 culpa is the voluntary-operation species, classified only with voluntary control and a due operation absent or disordered. This does not identify all privative evil with culpa, the q.94 predicate with culpa, or a culpa occurrence with a truth-apt sentence in the O'Connor signature.
